info.title: Product Admin API
info.description: RESTful API for managing products and categories. All endpoints except login require an admin Bearer token: call POST /api/login, then click "Authorize" and paste the token.

post.summary: Log in as admin and receive a Bearer token

get.summary: List all categories with their product counts

delete.summary: Delete a category (only when it has no products, including ones in the trash)

parameters.name: low_stock
parameters.description: Only products with stock of 10 or less

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending, e.g. -price

post.summary: Create a product. Send JSON, or multipart/form-data to attach an image

put.summary: Update a product (all fields optional). To upload an image, send POST with _method=PUT as multipart/form-data

delete.summary: Soft delete many products at once

get.summary: Export products to Excel (.xlsx), using the same filters as the list

parameters.name: low_stock
parameters.description: Only products with stock of 10 or less

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending, e.g. -price

get.summary: List products in the trash (soft deleted), most recently deleted first

200.description: Paginated list of deleted products (each includes deleted_at)

patch.summary: Restore a product from the trash

delete.summary: Permanently delete a product. It must be in the trash first

id.description:
Reusable OpenAPI schemas referenced by the API controllers.
This class holds documentation only and is never instantiated.

products_count.description: Active (not deleted) products. Only included on category endpoints

price.description: Decimal as string to avoid float rounding

ProductMultipartInput.description: Same fields as ProductInput, sent as multipart/form-data so an image can be attached. Booleans are sent as 1 or 0.

image.description: JPG, PNG or WebP, max 2 MB

remove_image.description: Updates only: 1 removes the current image

_method.description: Updates only: send POST with _method=PUT, because PHP does not parse multipart bodies on a real PUT

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

message.example: Only administrators can access this resource.

Conflict.description: The action conflicts with the current state of the resource

message.example: This category still has products. Move or permanently delete them first.

sanctum.description: Paste the token returned by POST /api/login.

tags.name: Trash
tags.description: Restore or permanently delete soft-deleted products
